Due date calculator Spain

Enter the first day of your last period to see your estimated due date, how far along you are today, and when each trimester starts.

  • Adjusts for cycle lengths from 20 to 45 days
  • Trimester dates and the 37–42 week term window
  • Runs in your browser — nothing is sent or stored

Your due date

The day bleeding started, not the day it stopped.

days

Days from the start of one period to the start of the next. Leave it at 28 if you are not sure.

08/10/2026

This is an estimate from the dates you enter, not a diagnosis. A dating scan measures the baby directly and replaces it.

01

Your pregnancy week by week

Pregnancy is dated from the first day of your last period, not from conception, and it runs for 40 weeks from there. Before 37 weeks is preterm, 42 weeks and over is post-term, and the weeks in between are when almost every baby actually arrives.

The table below is the whole 40 weeks, split the way maternity services split them.

02

How the due date is calculated

The estimate is Naegele's rule: 280 days, or 40 weeks, from the first day of your last period. That assumes a 28-day cycle with ovulation around day 14.

If your cycles are longer or shorter, ovulation moves with them, so the calculator shifts the date by the difference. A 32-day cycle puts the estimate four days later; a 24-day cycle brings it four days earlier.

Worked example: a last period starting on 1 January with a 28-day cycle gives 8 October. The same period with a 32-day cycle gives 12 October.

03

Why a dating scan replaces this estimate

A calculator can only work with the dates you give it. A scan measures the baby, which is why its date is the one your maternity team keeps using afterwards.

  • It depends on remembering the first day of your last period accurately.
  • It assumes you ovulated in the middle of your cycle, which not everyone does.
  • Irregular cycles, recently stopped contraception and breastfeeding all make the last period a weak anchor.
  • A first-trimester scan measures the baby, usually between about 11 and 14 weeks, and is accurate to within a few days.
  • After IVF the dating comes from the transfer date rather than a period, so this estimate does not apply.

04

When to contact a doctor or midwife

  • You think you are pregnant and have not yet arranged antenatal care — the first appointment and the dating scan both belong early.
  • You have bleeding, cramping or pain on one side in early pregnancy.
  • You have severe or constant vomiting, or cannot keep fluids down.
  • You have a long-term condition or take regular medicines — some need reviewing as soon as a pregnancy is confirmed.
  • You have reached 41 weeks, or you are past your due date and the baby's movements have changed.

Where to go from here

An estimated date is where antenatal care starts, not the whole of it. These are the consultations that take it further.

Questions

Due date calculator: FAQs

How accurate is a due date calculator?

The arithmetic is exact; the assumptions behind it are not. Only about one pregnancy in twenty ends on its estimated date, and the great majority of births happen in the weeks either side of it. A first-trimester scan is the accurate version, and once you have had one, its date is the one that is used.

How many weeks pregnant am I?

Pregnancy is counted from the first day of your last period, not from conception — which is why you are already around four weeks pregnant when a test first turns positive. Conception happens roughly two weeks after that first day, so the pregnancy is always dated about two weeks 'older' than the embryo.

What does 9w 3d mean?

Nine completed weeks and three days since the first day of your last period. Maternity records are written this way because a whole week is too coarse when a scan or a test has to happen inside a particular window.

Can I use this if my cycles are irregular?

You can, and entering your usual cycle length will get you closer than the 28-day default. But an irregular cycle is exactly the case where the last period is a weak anchor, so treat the result as a rough guide until you have been scanned.

Does the due date change after a scan?

Often, yes — usually by a few days. The scan measures the baby instead of counting from a remembered date, so it is the one that is kept. A change of a week or more is common when the date of the last period was uncertain.

Does this due date calculator store my details?

No. The calculation runs entirely in your browser. Nothing you type is sent to our servers or saved.

How do I arrange antenatal care in Spain?

Through your local health centre, where a midwife and your family doctor follow a low-risk pregnancy and refer you to hospital when needed. The first blood tests and the scan are arranged there, and the scan's date is the one kept in your pregnancy record.

When is the dating scan done in Spain?

The first-trimester scan is normally done between about 11 and 14 weeks, with the anomaly scan around week 20. Until then the estimate above is what you have — and our registered doctors can review early symptoms or medicines you already take by video.

Questions in early pregnancy?

Talk to a registered doctor by video about symptoms, the medicines you already take, or anything you would rather not sit on until your first appointment.
